run_llm_with_dummy_weights: run a vllm LLM model initialized with dummy weights instead of real ones
generate_text_with_sampling_params: generate text from prompts using vllm LLM with custom temperature and top_p sampling parameters
reload_weights_inplace: reload real model weights inplace using collective_rpc after updating the load format config
update_load_config_via_rpc: update the vllm engine load config at runtime using collective_rpc to change load_format
print_prompts_and_outputs: print formatted prompt and generated text pairs from a list of vllm RequestOutput objects
